themes.name: School Learning and Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve schools, teaching, learning opportunities, or student support within education settings, excluding transportation to school.

themes.name: Healthcare and Preventive Care
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, preventive, or in-home care for residents.

themes.name: Affordable Housing
themes.rule: Proposals that increase housing supply or affordability, improve private homes, or strengthen renter price transparency.

themes.name: Waste Reduction and Recycling
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce disposable waste or expand household collection, recycling, and composting systems.

themes.name: Urban Environment and Greenery
themes.rule: Proposals that improve environmental conditions through clean energy, air monitoring, trees, or community growing spaces.

themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make municipal information, procedures, requests, or internet connectivity easier to access digitally or with assisted access.

themes.name: Transit and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals that improve public transit, cycling, or the safety and convenience of moving through streets and crossings.

themes.name: Public Safety Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime, improve emergency response, or make public spaces feel safer through policing, surveillance, or lighting.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, career changes, local hiring, independent work, or small-business finance and operations.

themes.name: Arts and Cultural Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand public art, cultural performances, music instruction, or access to museums.

themes.name: Neighborhood Recreation Amenities
themes.rule: Proposals that add or improve local parks, playgrounds, libraries, or dedicated recreation spaces such as dog runs.
